ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This section is for the participants of the Champaign County Summer Ag Institute on Natural Resource Education øLearning about Ecosystems for Intelligent and Sustainable Use of Lands and Natural Resources using Math, Science and Readingø from June 12-15, 2007. Students may elect to register for 2 or 3 credit hours. Students will participate in 2 projects for 2 graduate credits and 3 projects for 3 graduate credits.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS: Agricultural Educ -UIUC or NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC.
